title: InnovaDigits Project Security Delivery Checklist V1.1

companyLevelEccSubdomains.title: Cybersecurity Governance & Strategy
companyLevelEccSubdomains.scopeNote: Organization-wide cybersecurity charter, mandate, and board reporting.

companyLevelEccSubdomains.title: Cybersecurity Management & Committee
companyLevelEccSubdomains.scopeNote: Enterprise cybersecurity committee cadence and cross-department oversight.

companyLevelEccSubdomains.title: Cybersecurity Policies & Standards
companyLevelEccSubdomains.scopeNote: Corporate security policy library, annual review, and executive approval.

companyLevelEccSubdomains.title: Cybersecurity Roles & Responsibilities
companyLevelEccSubdomains.scopeNote: Enterprise RACI separation of duties between IT/Engineering and Cybersecurity.

companyLevelEccSubdomains.title: Compliance with National Laws & Standards
companyLevelEccSubdomains.scopeNote: Corporate NCA, SDAIA PDPL, and sector regulatory audit governance.

companyLevelEccSubdomains.title: Cybersecurity Awareness & Training Program
companyLevelEccSubdomains.scopeNote: Company-wide phishing simulations, onboarding training, and developer workshops.

companyLevelEccSubdomains.title: Human Resources Cybersecurity
companyLevelEccSubdomains.scopeNote: Background screening, NDA clauses, onboarding least-privilege, and offboarding revocation.

companyLevelEccSubdomains.title: Workstation & Endpoint Device Security
companyLevelEccSubdomains.scopeNote: Developer/staff laptop EDR, disk encryption, MDM, and USB/media lockdowns.

companyLevelEccSubdomains.title: Corporate Email Protection
companyLevelEccSubdomains.scopeNote: Enterprise domain SPF, DKIM, DMARC p=reject, and anti-phishing gateway.

companyLevelEccSubdomains.title: Removable Media & BYOD Security
companyLevelEccSubdomains.scopeNote: Physical media restriction and corporate mobile device management.

companyLevelEccSubdomains.title: Physical & Environmental Security
companyLevelEccSubdomains.scopeNote: Data center physical access controls, CCTV, biometric cages, and environmental resilience.

controls.title: Assign named Project Security Owner & Security Reviewer with release veto authority
controls.passCriteria: Named Security Owner and independent Security Reviewer documented in project charter and sign-off matrix.

controls.title: Document delivery scope, exposed surfaces (Web/API/AI/Mobile), and system asset inventory
controls.passCriteria: security_profile in stack.json and asset inventory explicitly declare all active surfaces with zero unconfirmed toggles.

controls.title: Bind applicable regulatory baselines (Saudi NCA ECC 2:2024, PDPL, DGA, OWASP)
controls.passCriteria: Active compliance standards and regional hosting constraints declared in stack.json compliance & security_profile.

controls.title: Conduct pre-development cybersecurity risk assessment covering business & tenant threats
controls.passCriteria: Approved project risk register with likelihood, impact, and treatment owners signed prior to production.

controls.title: Perform architecture threat modeling (STRIDE / abuse cases) across auth, tenant, API, and AI boundaries
controls.passCriteria: Threat model document links trust boundaries, abuse cases, and compensating controls.

controls.title: Complete security architecture review of network, auth, storage, and integration topology
controls.passCriteria: Architecture diagram and boundary review approved with zero Clean Architecture or HMVC layer inversions.

controls.title: Enforce automated pre-commit, CI SAST/SCA, and Two-Gate engineering readiness checks in SDLC
controls.passCriteria: Pre-commit guard and CI security verification scripts active and blocking on Critical/High defects.

controls.title: Embed explicit security acceptance criteria and negative role tests in feature specifications
controls.passCriteria: Feature specs (Gate B Section 11 ENG-06/ENG-07/ENG-09) define RBAC, PII masking, and negative test bindings.

controls.title: Approve canonical Role-Permission Matrix across all system personas and tenant tiers
controls.passCriteria: Signed Role-Permission Matrix mapping every endpoint/action to allowed roles and ownership scopes.

controls.title: Verify engineering team adherence to stack-specific secure coding rules and lessons learned
controls.passCriteria: Stack-selective IDE security rules exported (<22KB) and LESSONS_LEARNED.md bound to active workflow.

controls.title: Classify data assets (Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted/PII) with handling rules
controls.passCriteria: Data classification matrix maps Tier-1/Tier-2 PII fields to AES-256 encryption, masking, and retention controls.

controls.title: Maintain end-to-end data flow diagrams covering ingress, storage, exports, backups, and external APIs
controls.passCriteria: Current data-flow diagram documents internal/external flows and TLS/encryption posture on each link.

controls.title: Complete cybersecurity due diligence and contractual controls for third-party APIs & SDKs
controls.passCriteria: Third-party integrations reviewed for TLS, least privilege, SLA, and incident notification clauses.

controls.title: Verify cloud provider compliance and KSA data residency alignment prior to deployment
controls.passCriteria: Cloud tenant region, residency attestation, and shared-responsibility matrix approved.

controls.title: Define periodic security review, compliance audit, and vulnerability reassessment schedule
controls.passCriteria: Governance calendar schedules periodic SAST/DAST, access review, and ECC compliance audits.

controls.title: Authenticate every non-public API and web endpoint server-side
controls.passCriteria: Zero non-public controllers, Minimal API groups, or routes reachable without auth:sanctum / [Authorize] / RequireAuthorization().

controls.title: Prohibit frontend-only authorization or reliance on hidden UI controls without server enforcement
controls.passCriteria: SPA router enforces navigation guards (beforeEach/middleware) AND backend independently enforces auth/RBAC.

controls.title: Remove all default, shared, test, and hard-coded credentials, tokens, and user GUIDs
controls.passCriteria: Zero hardcoded passwords, sa logins, JWT keys, API secrets, or static user/tenant UUIDs in source or config.

controls.title: Enforce approved password complexity, minimum length (>=12), breach check, and Argon2id/bcrypt/PBKDF2 hashing
controls.passCriteria: Strong password validator and adaptive one-way password hashing enforced on registration, invite, and reset.

controls.title: Enforce MFA for all administrative, privileged, and sensitive operational accounts
controls.passCriteria: Privileged/admin login enforces second factor (TOTP/WebAuthn/SSO MFA) with verified enrollment and enforcement evidence.

controls.title: Enforce login rate limiting and progressive lockout per account identifier AND client IP
controls.passCriteria: Login endpoints enforce strict rate-limit policies (throttle / RequireRateLimiting) returning 429 on burst attempts.

controls.title: Generate OTP codes using CSPRNG (random_int / RandomNumberGenerator) — prohibit static/predictable OTPs
controls.passCriteria: Zero static OTP literals (123456/0000) or insecure PRNG (rand/Math.random) in authentication/verification flows.

controls.title: Enforce strict throttling and max attempt lockouts across OTP request, resend, and verify endpoints
controls.passCriteria: OTP send/resend/verify endpoints apply explicit throttle middleware and invalidate code after bounded failed attempts.

controls.title: Enforce short OTP expiration TTL (<=5 minutes) and immediate single-use invalidation upon verification
controls.passCriteria: OTP records store hashed value with strict expires_at check and atomic consumption on first valid use.

controls.title: Prevent account takeover in password-reset flows (bind token to account, never trust client userId/email override)
controls.passCriteria: Reset flow resolves target user strictly from server-side hashed token record and invalidates active sessions on reset.

controls.title: Generate high-entropy single-use invitation and password-reset tokens stored hashed at rest
controls.passCriteria: Reset and invite tokens use >=32 bytes CSPRNG entropy, are stored via SHA-256/bcrypt hash, and expire on first use.

controls.title: Return uniform, timing-safe responses across login, forgot-password, registration, and invite endpoints
controls.passCriteria: Zero distinct "email not found" / "user does not exist" / "account inactive" oracle messages exposed to unauthenticated callers.

controls.title: Rotate session IDs and refresh/JWT tokens upon login, privilege change, MFA verification, and password reset
controls.passCriteria: Single token scheme active; refresh tokens rotate with reuse detection and privilege changes invalidate prior tokens.

controls.title: Enforce strict token/session expiration (ValidateLifetime=true, short access JWT TTL)
controls.passCriteria: JWT bearer validation enforces ValidateLifetime = true with bounded access-token TTL (<60m) and zero multi-week non-expiring tokens.

controls.title: Revoke sessions and bearer/refresh tokens server-side on logout (token delete / jti denylist)
controls.passCriteria: Logout endpoint revokes server-side Sanctum token / refresh family / JWT jti; previously issued token is rejected post-logout.

controls.title: Require step-up password or MFA re-verification prior to email/password change, payout, or key rotation
controls.passCriteria: Sensitive account/security mutations verify fresh authentication timestamp or secondary challenge.

controls.title: Enforce Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite=Lax/Strict attributes on all session and auth cookies
controls.passCriteria: Auth cookies set HttpOnly=true, Secure=true, SameSite=Strict/Lax; zero bearer tokens persisted in localStorage/sessionStorage.

controls.title: Bind mobile biometric authentication to hardware-backed Keystore/Keychain CryptoObject (OWASP MASVS-AUTH)
controls.passCriteria: BiometricPrompt authenticates a Keystore/Keychain cryptographic operation rather than a boolean callback.

controls.title: Enforce approved Role-Permission Matrix server-side via Policies, Gates, or MediatR AuthorizationBehaviours
controls.passCriteria: Every protected action verifies explicit permission/policy matching the approved Role-Permission Matrix.

controls.title: Configure deny-by-default fallback authorization policy across API routers and pipelines
controls.passCriteria: ASP.NET FallbackPolicy / MediatR pipeline or Laravel auth:sanctum group denies undeclared endpoints by default.

controls.title: Enforce object-level ownership and tenant authorization (IDOR defense) on every ID/UUID parameter
controls.passCriteria: All show/update/delete/nested lookups scope by authenticated user/tenant ownership and fail closed with 404 Not Found.

controls.title: Enforce explicit role/permission guards on all administrative, approval, and management endpoints
controls.passCriteria: Admin, approval, and configuration routes enforce explicit role/policy checks beyond bare [Authorize].

controls.title: Prevent vertical privilege escalation, self-role-assignment, and unauthorized permission grants
controls.passCriteria: Role assignment endpoints require privileged admin policy and prevent assigning roles higher than caller scope.

controls.title: Isolate tenant data, caches, files, exports, and background jobs strictly by server-resolved tenant_id
controls.passCriteria: Tenant ID resolved exclusively from auth context; global scopes/query filters, cache keys, and storage paths prevent cross-tenant access.

controls.title: Restrict user invitations, self-registration, and workspace/project team assignment to authorized roles
controls.passCriteria: Template open /register routes disabled or guarded; invitations validate caller tenant/project admin permission.

controls.title: Enforce strict ownership, role policy, and valid lifecycle state checks on delete, cancel, approve, and reject
controls.passCriteria: Delete/cancel/approve actions verify both caller policy and valid entity state before mutation.

controls.title: Enforce authorization, tenant scoping, batch size caps, and rate limits on bulk import/export/update/delete
controls.passCriteria: Bulk endpoints enforce per-item tenant ownership, hard batch count caps, and endpoint throttling.

controls.title: Filter all analytics, KPIs, and dashboard queries by caller role and authorized data/tenant scope
controls.passCriteria: Aggregate and reporting queries enforce mandatory tenant/department/branch scope filters.

controls.title: Authenticate and scope PDF/Excel export endpoints and store generated artifacts in private non-public storage
controls.passCriteria: Export endpoints require auth + throttling; generated files never written to public/ or wwwroot/exports.

controls.title: Enforce business-ownership authorization on every file preview and download stream
controls.passCriteria: Files streamed via authenticated controller/signed short-lived URL after verifying caller ownership; direct public URL access blocked.

controls.title: Scope notification list, read, mark-read, and delete operations strictly to recipient user_id
controls.passCriteria: Notification queries bind where user_id == authenticated caller ID; foreign notification IDs return 404.

controls.title: Prevent mass-assignment and over-posting via explicit $fillable whitelists and immutable request DTOs
controls.passCriteria: Zero $guarded = [], zero $request->all() persistence, and zero privilege/tenant fields in $fillable or bindable DTOs.

controls.title: Enforce response DTO/Resource projection, $hidden attributes, and Tier-1/2 PII field masking
controls.passCriteria: API responses use explicit Resource/DTO transformers hiding password hashes, tokens, secrets, and raw national IDs.

controls.title: Enforce deterministic state-machine transitions and block creator self-approval on maker-checker flows
controls.passCriteria: Domain state transitions reject illegal jumps and enforce distinct approver != requester where maker-checker applies.

controls.title: Enforce consistent authorization across all HTTP verbs and block Route::any / method-override bypasses
controls.passCriteria: Routes bind explicit HTTP verbs (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE); Route::any and unauthenticated HEAD/OPTIONS/method-override leaks blocked.

controls.title: Protect balance, quota, approval, and booking mutations with DB row locks / optimistic concurrency & idempotency
controls.passCriteria: Critical state/financial mutations execute inside atomic transactions with row version / pessimistic lock protection.

controls.title: Enforce parameterized SQL queries and strictly prohibit executing user- or AI-supplied raw SQL
controls.passCriteria: Zero interpolated DB::raw/whereRaw/FromSqlRaw/ExecuteSqlRaw and zero execution of LLM-generated SQL statements.

controls.title: Prohibit shell/OS command execution with untrusted input; use safe native APIs or argument arrays
controls.passCriteria: Zero shell_exec/exec/Process.Start/child_process.exec concatenating user or AI input.

controls.title: Enforce host allowlists, RFC1918/metadata IP blocking, and TLS certificate verification on outbound fetches
controls.passCriteria: Outbound HttpClient/Guzzle validates TLS certificates and blocks private/link-local IPs on user/PDF URLs.

controls.title: Canonicalize file paths and enforce storage-root prefix bounds to prevent Path Traversal / LFD
controls.passCriteria: Download/read handlers resolve storage keys from DB or validate Path.GetFullPath prefix / basename() before file access.

controls.title: Eliminate unsanitized HTML sinks (v-html, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML) to prevent Stored/DOM XSS
controls.passCriteria: Dynamic content rendered as escaped text or sanitized via hardened DOMPurify (>=3.1.3) under strict CSP.

controls.title: Block active/scriptable upload formats (SVG, HTML, JS, PHP, ASPX, EXE, SH) or serve strictly non-executable
controls.passCriteria: Upload extension/MIME allowlists exclude svg/html/js/php/aspx/exe and enforce Content-Disposition: attachment + nosniff.

controls.title: Validate uploaded files server-side by allowlisted extension, MIME type, AND binary magic-byte header
controls.passCriteria: Upload validators inspect actual binary signatures (finfo_file / FileSignature header bytes), never trusting client Content-Type.

controls.title: Enforce per-file byte limits, file count caps, and upload rate limits (forbid [DisableRequestSizeLimit])
controls.passCriteria: Zero [DisableRequestSizeLimit] attributes; upload endpoints enforce explicit max file size and request throttling.

controls.title: Integrate asynchronous/inline antivirus or malware quarantine scanning on untrusted file uploads
controls.passCriteria: Uploaded files pass ClamAV/Defender/cloud malware scan hook prior to downstream user distribution.

controls.title: Store uploaded files outside webroot (public/ or wwwroot/) using server-generated UUID/ULID filenames
controls.passCriteria: Uploads use private disk/bucket with generated UUID keys; zero getClientOriginalName() or wwwroot/FileServer writes.

controls.title: Sanitize HTML templates and disable local-file/SSRF network access prior to server-side PDF rendering
controls.passCriteria: PDF engines (DomPDF/Wkhtmltopdf/DinkToPdf/Puppeteer) sanitize dynamic HTML and block file:// and internal HTTP fetches.

controls.title: Disable DTD and external XML entity resolution across all XML, DOCX, XLSX, and SOAP parsers
controls.passCriteria: XML readers set DtdProcessing.Prohibit /XmlResolver = null / LIBXML_NONET with zero external entity expansion.

controls.title: Prohibit unsafe binary/type-name deserialization (BinaryFormatter, TypeNameHandling.All, unserialize)
controls.passCriteria: All JSON/queue payloads deserialize into strict static types without polymorphic untrusted type resolvers.

controls.title: Prohibit compiling user-controlled strings as Blade, Razor, Twig, or Liquid server templates
controls.passCriteria: Notification/email templates use fixed parameterized placeholders rather than dynamic template evaluation.

controls.title: Enforce anti-CSRF tokens and origin verification on all state-changing cookie-authenticated routes
controls.passCriteria: VerifyCsrfToken / ValidateAntiForgeryToken active on all cookie-authenticated POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE routes.

controls.title: Validate all request inputs (body, query, route params, headers) via FormRequest or FluentValidation allowlists
controls.passCriteria: Every mutating endpoint validates types, lengths, enums, and numeric ranges before invoking domain services.

controls.title: Apply context-aware HTML, attribute, URL, and JSON output encoding across UI views and responses
controls.passCriteria: Framework auto-escaping preserved across Vue/React/Blade/Razor templates; javascript: URLs rejected.

controls.title: Neutralize spreadsheet formula-injection prefixes (=, +, -, @, tab, CR) in exported CSV and Excel cells
controls.passCriteria: CSV/Excel export writers prefix leading =, +, -, @ characters on untrusted strings before cell serialization.

controls.title: Maintain complete OpenAPI inventory of all routes with authentication, role, and exposure metadata
controls.passCriteria: docs/modules/*.json or OpenAPI contract accurately inventories active endpoints and security schemes.

controls.domain: Disable Public API Docs in Prod
controls.title: Disable or gate Swagger, Scalar, and OpenAPI interactive UIs in Staging and Production environments
controls.passCriteria: Swagger/Scalar/OpenAPI UI wrapped in IsDevelopment() / non-production guard or strict admin authorization.

controls.title: Validate JWT signature, algorithm allowlist, issuer, audience, lifetime, and RequireHttpsMetadata=true
controls.passCriteria: JWT middleware enforces ValidateIssuerSigningKey, ValidateIssuer, ValidateAudience, ValidateLifetime=true, RequireHttpsMetadata=true.

controls.title: Enforce granular per-user/IP rate limits on auth, OTP, reset, upload, export, AI, and bulk endpoints
controls.passCriteria: High-cost and sensitive endpoints enforce dedicated rate-limit policies with Retry-After headers.

controls.title: Enforce mandatory server-side pagination with a hard maximum pageSize clamp (e.g. <=100)
controls.passCriteria: Collection endpoints paginate results and clamp client per_page/pageSize to a server ceiling; zero unbounded ::all().

controls.title: Enforce bounded request body size, JSON nesting depth, and array element limits
controls.passCriteria: Kestrel/Nginx/PHP max body size and JSON serializer MaxDepth configured without DisableRequestSizeLimit overrides.

controls.title: Validate request and response payloads against strict OpenAPI / typed contract schemas
controls.passCriteria: API responses conform to standardized envelope/ProblemDetails contracts without undocumented fields.

controls.title: Return generic error envelopes — never expose ex.Message, $e->getMessage(), SQL queries, or stack traces
controls.passCriteria: Global exception handler maps unhandled errors to generic 500 envelope with trace_id; zero raw exception messages returned.

controls.title: Enforce explicit Content-Type (application/json / multipart) and reject mismatches with 415 Unsupported Media Type
controls.passCriteria: API controllers/endpoints accept declared media types only and return 415 on unexpected Content-Type.

controls.title: Allow only required HTTP methods per route and disable TRACE / TRACK methods at server/router level
controls.passCriteria: TRACE disabled and routes explicitly declare single allowed HTTP verbs returning 405 on unsupported verbs.

controls.title: Enforce X-Idempotency-Key atomic locks on financial, checkout, and critical state-mutating POST/PATCH routes
controls.passCriteria: Critical mutation endpoints deduplicate retried requests via X-Idempotency-Key scoped to caller user/tenant.

controls.title: Enforce timestamps, nonces, or single-use state tokens on high-value signed API operations
controls.passCriteria: Sensitive signed requests verify bounded timestamp skew and single-use nonce/jti replay cache.

controls.title: Verify HMAC/asymmetric signatures, timestamp freshness, and event-ID idempotency on inbound webhooks
controls.passCriteria: Webhook receivers compute constant-time HMAC over raw body, enforce <=5m timestamp window, and deduplicate event IDs.

controls.title: Validate TLS certificates, enforce timeouts/circuit-breakers, and treat third-party API responses as untrusted
controls.passCriteria: Outbound HTTP clients enforce valid TLS certificates, explicit timeouts, and schema validation on external responses.

controls.title: Prefix endpoints with explicit /api/v{n} versioning and retire deprecated versions cleanly
controls.passCriteria: All API routes versioned (/api/v1/...) with zero unmaintained shadow or legacy v0 endpoints left active.

controls.title: Enforce explicit environment-configured CORS origin allowlist — forbid AllowAnyOrigin() or * in production
controls.passCriteria: CORS policy restricts origins to explicit trusted HTTPS domains; fails closed when allowed origins config is empty.

controls.title: Disable framework debug modes and developer exception pages in Staging and Production (APP_DEBUG=false)
controls.passCriteria: APP_DEBUG=false in non-local configs and UseExceptionHandler() active without UseDeveloperExceptionPage in production.

controls.title: Disable or strictly gate Telescope, Horizon, Hangfire, Clockwork, and debug profilers in production
controls.passCriteria: Telescope/Horizon/Hangfire dashboards restricted by strict admin policy + non-hardcoded auth or disabled in production.

controls.title: Emit HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy headers
controls.passCriteria: Web server / middleware emits Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy.

controls.title: Enforce effective Content-Security-Policy restricting script-src, object-src, base-uri, and third-party CDNs
controls.passCriteria: CSP header configured without unsafe-eval, self-hosting fonts/scripts and restricting connect-src/script-src.

controls.title: Enforce CSP frame-ancestors 'none'/'self' and X-Frame-Options: DENY/SAMEORIGIN
controls.passCriteria: All web routes emit frame-ancestors and X-Frame-Options preventing UI redressing / iframe embedding.

controls.title: Enforce HTTPS/TLS 1.2+ with HTTP->HTTPS redirect, valid certificates, and encrypted DB connections (Encrypt=True)
controls.passCriteria: Nginx/ingress redirects port 80 -> 443 TLS 1.2+, API/AI URLs use https://, and SQL connections enforce Encrypt=True.

controls.title: Suppress Server, X-Powered-By, and X-AspNet-Version headers (server_tokens off / AddServerHeader = false)
controls.passCriteria: Nginx server_tokens off, Kestrel AddServerHeader = false, and PHP expose_php = Off configured.

controls.title: Serve generic user-facing error pages/envelopes carrying a correlation trace_id without internal details
controls.passCriteria: Global error handler logs full diagnostic detail internally against trace_id while returning safe generic message to client.

controls.title: Emit Cache-Control: no-store on authenticated API responses, PII views, tokens, and exported files
controls.passCriteria: Authenticated API and sensitive document responses include Cache-Control: no-store, private.

controls.title: Disable JavaScript/TypeScript .map source maps and debug build artifacts in production bundles
controls.passCriteria: Vite/Nuxt/Webpack production build configuration sets sourcemap: false (or hidden non-public upload only).

controls.title: Remediate known vulnerable or EOL frontend npm packages (DOMPurify, Lodash, TinyMCE, Vue/React/Nuxt)
controls.passCriteria: Zero Critical/High vulnerabilities in frontend package.json / lockfile scan.

controls.title: Ensure zero API keys, DB passwords, or private tokens exist in VITE_*/NUXT_PUBLIC_* vars, public files, or git
controls.passCriteria: Zero secrets embedded in frontend env variables, client bundles, tracked config files, or repository archives.

controls.title: Implement multi-signal Root (Android) and Jailbreak (iOS) detection with tamper response
controls.passCriteria: App detects rooted/jailbroken environments and blocks or restricts regulated operations.

controls.title: Detect unauthorized emulator/simulator execution on production release builds
controls.passCriteria: Release binary detects emulator signatures and enforces risk policy.

controls.title: Verify APK/IPA signing certificate & Play Integrity / App Attest anti-repackaging checks at runtime
controls.passCriteria: Modified or re-signed APK/IPA binaries fail runtime integrity attestation.

controls.title: Detect dynamic instrumentation and hooking frameworks (Frida, Xposed, Substrate, Objection)
controls.passCriteria: Runtime defense terminates session when Frida/Xposed injection ports, maps, or hooks are present.

controls.title: Enable R8/ProGuard/Swift symbol stripping and control-flow obfuscation on release builds
controls.passCriteria: Decompiled APK/IPA strips debug symbols and obfuscates sensitive domain/security classes.

controls.title: Enforce TLS SPKI certificate pinning with backup pins and forbid cleartext traffic
controls.passCriteria: MITM proxy with custom CA certificate is rejected by mobile HTTP client.

controls.title: Store tokens and sensitive data exclusively in Android Keystore / EncryptedSharedPreferences and iOS Keychain
controls.passCriteria: Zero tokens or PII stored in plaintext SharedPreferences, NSUserDefaults, SQLite, or external storage.

controls.title: Eliminate hardcoded API keys in mobile binaries and disable Logcat/OSLog sensitive output in release
controls.passCriteria: Static strings/resource scan of APK/IPA and runtime device logs reveal zero secrets or PII.

controls.title: Protect sensitive mobile screens against UI overlay attacks (filterTouchesWhenObscured=true)
controls.passCriteria: Android views set filterTouchesWhenObscured / hideOverlayWindows on auth and approval screens.

controls.title: Prevent OS task-switcher snapshot caching and unauthorized screenshots on PII screens (FLAG_SECURE)
controls.passCriteria: FLAG_SECURE (Android) and background privacy blur overlay (iOS) active on authenticated views.

controls.title: Set android:exported="false" on internal Activities, Services, BroadcastReceivers, and ContentProviders
controls.passCriteria: AndroidManifest exports only explicitly required entry points protected by custom signature permissions.

controls.title: Use verified Android App Links / iOS Universal Links and strictly validate deep-link parameters
controls.passCriteria: Deep links verify assetlinks.json / apple-app-site-association and sanitize route/token parameters.

controls.title: Disable file:// access, universal file access, and untrusted JS bridges in mobile WebViews
controls.passCriteria: WebViews disable allowFileAccess/allowUniversalAccessFromFileURLs and restrict navigation to HTTPS allowlist.

controls.title: Prevent ptrace/JDWP/LLDB runtime debugger attachment in production mobile binaries
controls.passCriteria: Release build rejects debugger attachment and disables WebView remote debugging.

controls.title: Request only strictly necessary mobile OS permissions with runtime justification
controls.passCriteria: Manifest/Info.plist requests minimal permissions aligned with documented business features.

controls.title: Restrict copying/pasting or auto-clear sensitive OTP, IBAN, and credential fields from mobile clipboard
controls.passCriteria: Sensitive inputs mark clipboard data as sensitive/expiring or disable copy export.

controls.title: Disable third-party/predictive keyboard learning cache on password, PIN, and PII text fields
controls.passCriteria: Inputs set TYPE_TEXT_FLAG_NO_SUGGESTIONS / autocorrectionType = .no on confidential fields.

controls.title: Sign release builds with hardware/vault production key, android:debuggable="false", and allowBackup="false"
controls.passCriteria: Production manifest sets debuggable=false, allowBackup=false, and uses dedicated release signing certificate.

controls.title: Enforce strict role separation, XML/delimiter fencing, and anti-override instructions on untrusted prompt inputs
controls.passCriteria: System prompts never concatenate raw user/attachment text without explicit untrusted-data delimiters and instruction guards.

controls.title: Verify caller userId and tenantId object-level authorization BEFORE loading entities or attachments into AI prompts
controls.passCriteria: Prompt context builders enforce caller tenant_id & ownership ACL prior to reading documents, comments, or attachments.

controls.domain: Block Schema & Secret Disclosure to AI
controls.title: Prohibit sending live DB schema (information_schema), connection strings, or system secrets to external AI models
controls.passCriteria: Zero information_schema dumps, secret env vars, or cleartext HTTP calls in AI/ML integration services.

controls.title: Enforce deterministic tool allowlists, strict JSON argument schemas, and human approval on mutating AI tool calls
controls.passCriteria: AI tool-calling cannot invoke undeclared functions or mutate state without schema validation and user confirmation.

controls.title: Treat all LLM/ML output as untrusted — sanitize HTML rendering and NEVER execute output as SQL, shell, or eval
controls.passCriteria: Zero ExecuteSqlRaw/DB::statement/eval on AI outputs; UI sanitizes rendered markdown/HTML via DOMPurify.

controls.title: Enforce per-user/tenant rate limits, max input length, max_tokens ceilings, and request timeouts on AI endpoints
controls.passCriteria: AI endpoints enforce dedicated rate-limiting middleware, bounded input character limits, and bounded token budgets.

controls.title: Verify external AI provider DPA, zero-training retention opt-out, PII redaction, and KSA data-residency compliance
controls.passCriteria: Approved AI vendor agreement confirms zero model training on customer data and compliant regional data processing.

controls.title: Enforce mandatory tenant_id and document-level ACL metadata filters inside every vector/RAG similarity query
controls.passCriteria: Vector/embedding retrieval queries filter strictly by authenticated tenant_id and caller permission scope.

controls.title: Redact PII and confidential payloads from AI prompt/completion logs while retaining abuse audit metadata
controls.passCriteria: Application loggers never dump raw unredacted prompt/response bodies containing user PII or secrets.

controls.title: Require explicit human review and override capability before AI outputs affect scoring, HR, legal, or financial decisions
controls.passCriteria: AI recommendations are labeled advisory and require authenticated human confirmation prior to final persistence.

controls.title: Enforce strict network, credential, database, and key separation between Dev, Staging, and Production
controls.passCriteria: Production VPC/VNet, DB instances, and signing keys are completely isolated from non-production environments.

controls.title: Prohibit unmasked production data, .bacpac/.bak/.sql dumps, and credential archives in source control
controls.passCriteria: Zero .bacpac, .bak, .sql data dumps or credential .zip artifacts present in repository tree.

controls.title: Expose only HTTPS (443) publicly; block direct internet access to DB (1433/3306/5432), Redis (6379), and SSH/RDP
controls.passCriteria: Security groups / firewall rules restrict public ingress strictly to reverse proxy/ALB port 443.

controls.title: Require VPN/Zero-Trust bastion with MFA for all server, Kubernetes, database, and cloud console administration
controls.passCriteria: Administrative infrastructure access gated by MFA-enforced VPN/bastion with zero public SSH/RDP keys.

controls.title: Connect applications using dedicated least-privilege DB accounts — strictly forbid sa, root, or postgres superusers
controls.passCriteria: Connection strings use dedicated app login with DML-only privileges; zero sa/root usage.

controls.title: Inject production secrets at runtime from Vault / AWS Secrets Manager / Azure Key Vault — never tracked files
controls.passCriteria: Runtime secrets provisioned via managed vault with IAM audit logging and zero plaintext files on repo.

controls.title: Maintain documented rotation capability and schedule for JWT signing keys, AES keys, and API credentials
controls.passCriteria: Key rotation runbook and kid/key-ring support allow rotating signing/encryption keys without downtime.

controls.title: Enable AES-256 encryption at rest on databases, disks, object buckets, and caches alongside TLS 1.2+ in transit

controls.title: Configure all S3/Azure Blob/MinIO buckets with Block Public Access enabled and private IAM policies

controls.title: Scope workload IAM roles/managed identities to exact buckets, queues, and secrets (zero AdministratorAccess/*)

controls.title: Apply CIS benchmark hardening baseline to host OS, IIS/Nginx/Apache, PHP-FPM, and Kestrel runtimes

controls.title: Maintain current security patch levels across OS packages, .NET/PHP/Node runtimes, Composer, NuGet, and npm

controls.title: Run containers as non-root UID, pin minimal base images, drop Linux capabilities, and scan images in CI

controls.title: Enforce branch protection, signed/reviewed PR merges, masked CI secrets, and isolated build runners

controls.title: Configure DNS CAA/SPF/DMARC records and automated TLS certificate renewal monitoring (>=30d expiry alert)

controls.title: Isolate Redis/RabbitMQ/SQS queues per environment/tenant and lock Hangfire/Horizon worker dashboards

controls.title: Use dedicated, non-interactive named service accounts per workload integration with zero human sharing

controls.title: Host databases, object storage, backups, logs, and DR replicas strictly inside Kingdom of Saudi Arabia regions

controls.title: Version-control IaC/reverse-proxy/firewall configurations and maintain encrypted off-host config backups

controls.title: Record immutable audit trail for role changes, user invitations, permission edits, exports, and destructive deletes

controls.title: Ship application, web server, WAF, and DB security logs to centralized append-only SIEM/log storage
controls.passCriteria: Logs forwarded out-of-band to centralized collector where application runtime cannot delete or alter historical entries.

controls.title: Enforce minimum 12-month security audit log retention (or higher sector mandate) with archival integrity
controls.passCriteria: SIEM/log bucket lifecycle policy retains security audit logs >=365 days in KSA storage.

controls.title: Configure automated alerts on brute-force spikes, 401/403/500 anomalies, privilege escalations, and WAF blocks

controls.passCriteria: Incident response runbook defines severity tiers, containment steps, and regulatory breach notification timelines.

controls.title: Maintain automated, AES-256 encrypted, network-isolated/immutable database and object-storage backups

controls.title: Execute and document a successful end-to-end backup restoration test into an isolated environment prior to go-live
controls.passCriteria: Restore drill evidence records RPO/RTO timings and data integrity verification checksums.

controls.title: Validate Business Continuity Plan (BCP), multi-AZ/failover readiness, and agreed RTO/RPO targets
